args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 (the latest deploy) started failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with an error rate of ~18%. Automated rollback was executed to v2.3.0, the most recent production release with a healthy status. Rollback completed successfully across all three regions and the service is now healthy again with an error rate of ~0.2%. Root cause of the v2.3.1 regression remains unknown and needs investigation.
args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1, failing health checks in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
2. **Rolled back**: Deployed v2.3.0 (the most recent release with a healthy production status) across all regions. Verified post-rollback health: all regions running v2.3.0, healthy, error rate ~0.2%.
3. **Opened SEV2 incident**: "checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0," documenting the failure and the rollback. The on-call engineer has been paged, and the incident notes that the root cause of the v2.3.1 regression still needs investigation.
